name: Halloween
description: A limited pack for Halloween (31 October 2027). Carved jack-o'-lanterns, pumpkins and gourds, a fruit bat, a barn owl, a tarantula, cobwebs, fly agaric, a haunted-looking house and spooky bakes, playable for one week.
